messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] page break within code chunks
parts:
You do have to follow the suggestion by Jeff Newmiller
(https://stat.ethz.ch/pipermail/r-help/2014-July/420348.html) -- a
knitr question is a subset of R questions. I think it is completely
fine to ask it in r-help, and I have already answered it there. Now
you post a duplicate question in this mailing list. To avoid wasting
time chasing people around, I recommend you to post questions to SO in
the future: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/knitr Hopefully
nobody will suggest you move to a different place any more
(http://article.gmane.org/gmane.comp.lang.r.general/303009).

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
